sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.series) c.series, c.market_ticker, c.yes_sub_title, c.strike_type, left(m.title,80) AS title FROM mmsell_candidate_ticks c LEFT JOIN markets m ON m.ticker=c.market_ticker WHERE c.series IN ('KXNCAAFSPREAD','KXNCAAFTOTAL','KXNCAAFGAME','KXNCAAF1HSPREAD','KXNCAAFTEAMTOTAL','KXNCAAF1HTOTAL','KXNCAAF2HSPREAD','KXNCAAF1QSPREAD','KXNCAAF1H','KXNFLRECYDS','KXNFLFIRSTTD','KXNFLREC','KXNFLTEAMTOTAL','KXNFL1HSPREAD','KXNFLPASSTDS','KXNFL2HSPREAD','KXNFL1H','KXNFL1QTOTAL','KXNFL1QSPREAD','KXNFL3QSPREAD','KXNFL2HTOTAL','KXNFL1HFT','KXNFL1HTEAMTOTAL','KXNFL4QSPREAD','KXNFLWINMARGIN','KXNFLRRYDS') AND c.captured_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY c.series, c.captured_at DESC
